work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CCCXXVI (garbled numeral oC Ore 4k #, protocol GREGORIUS PP. XVI. ad perpetuam rei memoriam LF60599–60602) motu proprio constitutes an apostolic vicariate in the Capuchin mission of Madras, transferring to the vicar spiritual jurisdiction and the mission's temporal rights in the name of Propaganda, and ends with its own 25 April 1834 closing at LF60705, before numeral CCCXXVII at LF60708. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF60599–60599; the source closing at LF60702–60705 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quinta aprilis millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quarto, pontificatus Nostri anno quarto. LF60693 (t Ex-lure Pont. de P, F,) is its own provenance note 1, excluded with the head of page 396 (396 ACTA, LF60696); LF60610 is page number 395. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
